summary: Tine electric piano (Rhodes) with chorus: lofi, neo-soul, jazz, R&B
label: Rhodes
body: 7th and 9th chords in MIDI 48-72; the warm keys of lofi and neo-soul. Drier: GeneralUser GS/Tine Electric Piano.

Register: MIDI 40-84 (openDAW names C3 = 60); outside it, it sounds wrong. Sound: GeneralUser GS/Chorused Tine EP, a sampled instrument: make_instrument (sound "GeneralUser GS/Chorused Tine EP") makes the track with its notes in one edit; apply makes it empty.
